read_protocol.payload_storage: one synchronous 1024x32 BRAM or equivalent registered service
read_protocol.coherence: Read status and revision before and after all payload words; require identical block_id, companion_scan_attempt_seq, revision, record_valid bits and inactive scanner/writer on both reads. Reject sequence wrap flag and any reset/identity mismatch. No legacy published-generation requirement for incomplete attempts.
read_protocol.reset_rule: Reset invalidates all W3 valid bits and block identity and returns pause OFF. Host must re-admit a nonzero block ID and identity after reset; zero payload is not historical success.

header_registers.name: SCHEMA_SHA256
header_registers.reset: contract file SHA256 split into eight dwords

control.unaligned_or_unknown_or_multi_bit: reject_count_saturates; last_reject set; no side effect
control.staged_block_id_write: 0x13810 full dword nonzero only while idle and unlocked
control.configuration_admission: scanner IDLE, executor idle, no I2C ownership/busy, no snapshot/response ownership pending, block unlocked
control.arm_admission: same idle conditions, nonzero staged block ID, block unlocked; lock configured mode and ID
control.close_admission: same idle conditions except block locked is required; release block lock, effective mode OFF
control.clear_admission: same idle conditions and block unlocked; clears W3 records/counters/samples only, never scanner lockout or legacy snapshot
control.write_response: ordinary completed MMIO write; host must check reject counter, last reject, status and block ID readback

word1_bits.4:2: first_detected_raw_cause; zero if no detected fault
word1_bits.7:5: completion_raw_cause; separate from first detected cause

words2_3_bits.62:59: maximum_wait_phase_class; zero means unavailable, otherwise maximum is valid even when wait value is zero

attempt_companion_format.slot_validity: Separate validity mask is cleared at scan admission, set only after all four words committed; invalid reads return zero. Outcome zero is absent, never inferred success.
attempt_companion_format.wait_definition: Consecutive core clock cycles waiting for released SCL to be recognized HIGH; includes input/filter latency, not a physical stretching measurement.

first_terminal_records.validity: independent valid bits, first captures earliest failed operation, terminal captures terminal scan failure; if same operation, same transaction_sequence and SAME_OPERATION flag

words.0: FLAGS exact bit map in record_word0_bits
words.1: retention epoch, increment on accepted explicit W3 clear; reset invalidates
words.5: kind/retry/group/entry/position exact bit map in record_word5_bits
words.6: current bank[7:0], target bank[15:8], register[23:16], write value[31:24]
words.7: first detected raw cause[2:0], timeout[3], master phase[9:4], bit[12:10], reserved[31:13]
words.8: completion raw cause[2:0], timeout[3], legacy scanner mapped cause[7:4], success[8], reserved[31:9]
words.9: maximum wait[10:0], full master phase[16:11], bit[19:17], reserved[31:20]
words.10: WADDR ACK wait[10:0], valid[11], REGADDR ACK wait[22:12], valid[23], reserved[31:24]
words.11: DATA ACK wait[10:0], valid[11], RADDR ACK wait[22:12], valid[23], reserved[31:24]
words.14: verify origin transaction sequence; valid in FLAGS bit7
words.15: verify delta FPGA cycles, valid FLAGS bit8; if overflow FLAGS bit22 set and bit8 clear
words.16: select outcome[1:0], verify outcome[3:2], restore outcome[6:4], reserved[31:7]
words.17: select transaction sequence, valid FLAGS bit9
words.18: verify transaction sequence, valid FLAGS bit10
words.19: restore transaction sequence, valid FLAGS bit11
words.20: related first/original failure transaction sequence, valid FLAGS bit12
words.21: first detected fault tick low 32 bits; valid FLAGS bit4
words.22: first detected fault tick high 32 bits; valid FLAGS bit4
words.24..27: same-kind successful control four-word attempt companion; valid FLAGS bit13
words.28: successful control block ID, valid FLAGS bit13
words.29: successful control scan-attempt sequence, valid FLAGS bit13
words.30: successful control location: group[3:0], entry[10:4], group-valid[11], entry-valid[12], reserved[31:13]; valid FLAGS bit13
words.31: payload revision captured at record commit

first_terminal_records.lifetime: Survives retry, restore, legacy ACK_CLEAR and later scans until accepted W3 clear or reset; updating terminal does not overwrite first. Records are coherent only under read_protocol.

record_word0_bits.2: effective pause mode at failed scan admission
record_word0_bits.3: first and terminal refer to same master transaction sequence
record_word0_bits.22: verify delta exceeds 32 bits or tick wraps

record_word5_bits.22:15: position within group or entry; validity in FLAGS

count_region.count_rule: Count accepted and completed actual master attempts, including partial scans and uncompleted publication. All 32-bit counters saturate; EVENT_OVERFLOW_FLAGS identifies any saturation. Clear only on accepted W3 clear or reset, independent of companion per-scan lifetime.

group_region.slot_layout: select attempt words 0..3; verify attempt words 4..7
group_region.validity: per-slot validity mask, group index and expected bank from frozen manifest; select failure means verify slot absent, not failed

entry_region.slot_layout: first attempt words 0..3; optional retry words 4..7
entry_region.validity: per-slot validity mask, index/register/bank from frozen manifest; retry never replaces first

aux_region.successful_controls: 0x146B0..0x1476F, six operation kinds x eight words: four-word attempt, block ID, scan-attempt sequence, location/validity, captured revision. Deterministic most-recent-success per kind until first record freezes; thereafter retain sample with records until explicit clear/reset. If no same-kind sample is present at failure, its embedded sample-valid bit is zero; no substitution.

lifetime_and_sequence.scan_attempt_sequence: increments once at accepted scan admission independently of legacy published generation; 32-bit wrap flag is sticky until clear/reset
lifetime_and_sequence.companion: represents most recent admitted scan, including incomplete; validity masks reset at admission and freeze after writer drain; revision changes at admission and freeze
lifetime_and_sequence.first_terminal: retained across scans, legacy ACK_CLEAR and recovery; explicit safe W3 clear or reset only
lifetime_and_sequence.successful_samples: deterministic most-recent success per kind until first failed record freezes comparison set; embeds sample validity at first/terminal capture; unavailable is explicit
lifetime_and_sequence.block: staged configuration persists unlocked; arm freezes mode and ID; scan latches effective mode and ID at admission; close releases lock but retained records keep former identity
lifetime_and_sequence.counter: since accepted clear/reset; includes partial and no-publication attempts
lifetime_and_sequence.tick_counter: 64-bit FPGA cycles; subtraction modulo 2^64 only when both origins valid and no observed wrap; delta overflow flag otherwise

safe_scope.only_new_functional_i2c_effect: optional 18750-cycle scanner-owned pause after a successful 0xFF bank write and before its existing verification command

EFFECTIVE_MODE.0: latched mode of active or last admitted scan
